title: Herbaceous Tunisian Chicken Tagine
description: A quick, savory tagine featuring coconut milk and a classic soffritto base, packed with aromatic herbs.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a tagine or heavy pot over medium heat until shimmering.
Add diced onion, sliced carrot, minced garlic, and grated ginger; sauté until onions turn translucent and aromatics soften.
Stir in the dried oregano, thyme, mint, and cumin, cooking for 1 minute to bloom the spices.
Place the chicken thighs into the pot, browning them on all sides over medium heat.
Pour in the coconut milk and chicken broth, then bring to a gentle simmer.
Cover the pot, reduce heat to low, and let the tagine cook for 25 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld.
Uncover, stir, and check seasoning, adding salt and pepper to taste.
Continue simmering uncovered for an additional 10 minutes, or until the chicken is fully cooked and the sauce has thickened.
Sprinkle chopped fresh parsley over the dish for a fresh finish.
Serve hot with lemon wedges on the side.
